AXONIUS PLATFORM
SaaS Applications
Full SaaS discovery, hygiene, and risk visibility – built as an extension of your asset intelligence, not another standalone tool.
Request a Demo
The world’s top companies rely on Axonius
SaaS sprawl is an asset intelligence problem. Treat it like one.
Axonius SaaS Applications extends asset intelligence to the application layer – discovering every app in use and correlating it to the devices, identities, and exposures it touches. Teams uncover shadow SaaS, close hygiene gaps, prioritize SaaS-driven risk, and reclaim wasted spend from one place.
Total SaaS visibility
Eliminate SaaS blind spots
Ingest data from identity providers, SSO, endpoint telemetry, and direct integrations to continuously discover sanctioned, unsanctioned, and unmanaged SaaS – including shadow apps, OAuth tokens, and risky extensions.
Cross-domain correlation
SaaS risk in full asset context
Map every SaaS app to the devices accessing it, identities with permissions, and exposures it introduces. Surface risks standalone SaaS tools can't see – like unmanaged devices hitting sensitive apps without required controls.
SaaS Hygiene and Posture
Catch drift before it compounds
Identify orphaned accounts, stale access, ungoverned integrations, and misconfigured settings. Continuously monitor hygiene across all applications so gaps surface early, not during an audit.
Spend and License Optimization
Stop paying for what no one uses
Identify unused accounts, redundant applications, and inactive licenses. Reclaim waste and right-size SaaS spend with visibility into actual usage correlated to users and devices.
Ready to take action with your SaaS Application Landscape?
Schedule a personalized demo with an Axonius specialist.
Contact Sales
Key Differentiators
SaaS visibility that extends your asset intelligence instead of standing apart from it
SaaS as an asset class, not a silo
SaaS Applications isn't a standalone tool, it extends Axonius asset intelligence, so SaaS context enriches every security program you run.
Correlation no SSPM can match
Map SaaS apps to devices, identities, exposures, and infrastructure. Understand who accesses what, from where, and whether it creates risk.
Discovery through existing deployments
No agents, no proxies, no inline inspection. Axonius discovers SaaS through the integrations and identity sources already in your stack.
One operating model across asset types
Manage SaaS hygiene the same way you manage device and identity hygiene – same platform, same workflows, same enforcement engine.
